map.dBm 与 dBi 不是同一物理量，但在对数预算中可相加：Pt(dBm)+Gt(: dBm and dBi are different quantities but can be added in a logarithmic budget: Pt(dBm)+Gt(dBi)=EIRP(dBm), then subtract FSPL. The result is a free-space theoretical value; measured range is usually shorter.
